numactl --cpunodebind=0 --membind=0 -- /usr/bin/qemu-system-x86_64 -machine q35,accel=kvm,mem-merge=off -cpu EPYC,topoext -D /mnt/xz_vm_storage/vm_0/qemu.log -m 2048M,maxmem=2048M -object memory-backend-ram,id=vmram0,size=2048M,host-nodes=0,policy=bind,prealloc=on -numa node,nodeid=0,memdev=vmram0 -numa cpu,node-id=0,socket-id=0,core-id=0,thread-id=0 -numa cpu,node-id=0,socket-id=0,core-id=1,thread-id=0 -numa cpu,node-id=0,socket-id=0,core-id=2,thread-id=0 -numa cpu,node-id=0,socket-id=0,core-id=3,thread-id=0 -numa cpu,node-id=0,socket-id=0,core-id=4,thread-id=0 -numa cpu,node-id=0,socket-id=0,core-id=5,thread-id=0 -numa cpu,node-id=0,socket-id=0,core-id=6,thread-id=0 -numa cpu,node-id=0,socket-id=0,core-id=7,thread-id=0 -numa dist,src=0,dst=0,val=10 -smp 8,maxcpus=8,sockets=1,cores=8,threads=1 -enable-kvm -display none -chardev socket,id=serial0,path=/mnt/xz_vm_storage/vm_0/serial.sock,server=on,wait=off,logfile=/mnt/xz_vm_storage/vm_0/serial.log -serial chardev:serial0 -daemonize -device virtio-rng-pci -pidfile /mnt/xz_vm_storage/vm_0/qemu.pid -device virtio-blk-pci,packed=on,num-queues=1,drive=drive0,id=virblk0 -drive if=none,file=/mnt/xz_vm_storage/vm_0/root.img,format=raw,media=disk,id=drive0,cache=none,aio=native -device virtio-net-pci,netdev=netssh0,mac=de:ad:be:ef:20:00 -netdev user,id=netssh0,hostfwd=tcp:127.0.0.1:10022-:22 -device ivshmem-plain,memdev=ivshmem -object memory-backend-file,size=32768M,share=on,mem-path=/mnt/xz_shared_mem/ivshmem_shared_mem,id=ivshmem -taskset 0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7
